recipes.name: Jim's Apple Raisin Pound Cake with Praline Glaze
ingredients_raw: 3 cups apples - peeled, cored and shredded

steps.text: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease a 10-inch Bundt pan. In a bowl, whisk together the flour, baking soda, allspice, and 1 teaspoon of salt.
In a large bowl, mix the vegetable oil, 2 cups of sugar, eggs, apples, 1 cup of pecans, and raisins. Mix the flour mixture into the wet ingredients, and pour the batter into the prepared Bundt pan.

Bake in the preheated oven until a toothpick inserted into the center of the cake comes out with moist crumbs, about 70 minutes. Let the cake cool in the pan for about 10 minutes, then turn out onto a rack to finish cooling.

For glaze, mix 1/2 cup of white sugar, the brown sugar, half and half, and 1/4 teaspoon of salt in a saucepan. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to medium-low, and boil, stirring constantly, until the mixture thickens to a syrup, 5 to 10 minutes. A candy thermometer will read 220 degrees F (105 degrees C). At that point, stir in butter, 1 cup of pecans, and vanilla extract. Continue to cook and stir until the syrup reaches 234 degrees F (110 degrees C). Allow the glaze to cool for 5 minutes, then spread the warm glaze over the cake.

raw_recipe.headline: Jim's Apple Raisin Pound Cake with Praline Glaze
raw_recipe.description: A rich, moist cake flavored with apples, raisins, allspice, and pecans gets a warm caramel glaze chock-full of more pecans.

review.reviewBody: I made this cake with a few revisions, it is excellent. I used two cups chunky apple sauce and added 1/2 teaspoon of cinnamon. Also added 1/2 cup extra flour, to make up for added moisture of applesauce. When I made the glaze I added 1/4 cup Brandy instead of vanilla, remove from flame when adding it. It is now one of my favorites.

Loved by lots when I made. I made this according to recipe with some small changes because I didn't have everything on hand. My changes were since I didn't have allspice I used 1 1/4 teaspoons cinnamon, 1/2 teaspoon of ground clove and 1/4 teaspoon of grated whole nutmeg. I also didn't have quiet a half cup of half and half so I added dark rum, around 2 tablespoons. I think this actually thinned the glaze a tad, but it soaked into the cake and made it super moist. It was definitely a hit and also a goner. Will make again!!!

Nice cake recipe but the best part is the "glaze". I have frequently made the praline glaze as a candy for parties. We use heavy whipping cream and let them set up in mini cupcake liners. We also prefer to use chopped pecans.

Made this cake for my family last evening. Served it while it was still a little warm and not one piece was left. I did add some extra spices to the cake like 1 teaspoon each of ginger and nutmeg then 1 tablespoon of cinnamon. I only used 1/2 cup of crop pecans in the glaze. The glaze harden into a candy like shell which broke a part when we cut into it. I'm not sure if I did something wrong but the guess just gathered up the broken pieces and ate that too. Already getting request to make it again.
I didn't have any raisins so I added more apples. Came out perfect. Everyone loved it!

This was excellent!! Made it according to the recipe and it turned out to me, perfectly. We had friends over when I just took it out of the oven and didn't have a chance to put the praline on the cake. So when it cooled, they had a piece and suggested not to put the praline on. My husband also asked me not to put anything on not even a glaze. They won, I left it plain and it was still so good. Everyone has their own opinion!!

We made this twice - it is one of our favorites - it is divine - thanks Jim!! Only question I have it - how do you cook the glaze and keep it glossy - once it cools and sits it gets dull. But that doesn't affect the taste :~))
As a professional cook for many years, I can tell you that this in one of the best cake recipes I've ever made!
Really was plain I followed directions and felt the cake really needed something.
Completely amazing! Nothing should be changed about it.

Man, oh man, this is a delicious cake. I followed the recipe exactly, except used a caramel glaze instead. The cake itself is now my only way to kick off Autumn. Hearty yet super moist- simply awesome.
I served this to a dinner party of 13 people and everyone raved about it. It is delicious and so easy to make. The sauce is delicious and adds extra sweetness. I'll definiately make this again.
l brought this cake to a potluck supper and everyone loved it.lt was moist and the topping made the cake tastier.Thanks alot everyone wanted this recipe.
